name: Sour djam tang
summary: Djam tang pickled sour and served as a dip for grilled meat and fish.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 24 Jun 2013 says rau djam tang is also pickled sour, for dipping grilled meat and fish.
howToEat: Take a little with each piece of grilled meat or fish.
seoTitle: Djam tang muoi chua — sour river green
seoDescription: Djam tang, a fine river green, pickled sour as a dip for grilled meat and fish.
